principle: Every visible MMIR control must either complete a useful free/local action, open the exact next surface, or explain a protected/planned boundary.
public_repo_rule: Public-safe audit only. It must not contain secrets, user prompts, provider keys, billing configuration or private telemetry.

controls.result: Sends the prompt through the active free guide, browser model or verified backend route.
Creates or reuses the free local-node profile and opens the model library so the user can pick a real free model path.
Creates or reuses the free local-node profile and opens the compact composer model picker from the plus button.
Lets users choose live backend, browser helper, WebGPU or installable free local models from the chat composer without starting paid routes.
Toggles Private, Boost, MMIR++ and Vision mode locally and applies the mode instruction on the next answer.
Starts browser speech recognition when available or shows a clear unsupported-browser message.
source_evidence: Voice input is not available in this browser.

controls.result: Retry, repair, install, connect settings, send first answer and save chat actions route to the exact next surface.
Starter model cards hand exact free model ids into runtime selection, local install and proof preference.
Guided repair cards open installer, pairing, model install or tunnel controls from doctor state.
After a verified first answer, opens the next useful step: connect node, save chat or add memory.
Protected or paid provider work stays blocked until explicit backend policy, identity and cost approval exist.
source_evidence: skipped to avoid hidden provider cost
